messages:
asha: Quick PSA: the ancient French press in the kitchen has been officially dubbed 'Captain Caff' by me and two interns. Long live the Captain. :coffee::anchor:
ben: bless. Captain Caff has steered us through many late deploys. :tada:
riley: we should have a tiny captain's hat for it. I can crochet. :scissors:
devon: hat + sash + a nameplate that says 'First Mate: Biscotti' (for the communal jar).
tess: can we get a sticker run? imagine Captain Caff stickers on laptops. very branding adjacent. :sticker:
asha: poll: what should the inaugural ritual be? react with :cup_with_straw: for 'Morning Toast' (everyone raises cups at 10am), :bell: for 'Ship's Bell' (ring bell when starting coffee), :star2: for 'Anthem' (1-line chant).
ben: :bell: the bell is content-agnostic and highly dramatic
riley: :star2: anthem support, I'll write lyrics
devon: also we need a rule: if Captain Caff is empty, you must refill immediately. no exceptions.
ops-bot: reminder queued: "Refill Captain Caff if below 1/4" every weekday at 9:45. :robot_face:
tess: also idea: a laminated logbook by the press to record who brewed what roast. could be funny.
asha: yes! call it "Captain's Log". riley will compose anthem and devon will design nameplate. tess, get sticker quotes. ben, find a bell.
ben: found a small brass bell on etsy, saving link: https://etsy.example.com/listing/12345 - cheap + ship 3 days
riley: rough anthem draft: "Oh Captain Caff, brew steady and true, keep our stack warm and our sprints anew." needs a bridge. :musical_note:
devon: bridge: "Percolate through midnight merge, steady hands and zero purge" (cringe maybe) :laughing:
tess: love the cringe, it's lore. stickers will say "I served Captain Caff" or just the anchor+cup icon
asha: logistics: sticker budget ok with snacks fund? quick vote in thread please. also who wants to be honorary XO (vice-captain) for week 1
ben: I'll be XO week 1. will ring bell ceremonially. :bell:
riley: XO duties: ensure anthem performed during standup on Friday.
asha: decision: bell ritual wins by emoji. plan: craft hat/riley anthem/devon nameplate/tess stickers/ben bell. ceremonial debut next Friday 10:00. meeting invite to follow. long live Captain Caff. :coffee:
